annotations.title: Extract text and tables from a PDF

description: Extract text and tables from a born-digital PDF (one made by software: invoices, statements, reports, contracts, forms), page by page in reading order, with any tables found from the text layout returned as rows of cells. Scanned PDFs (images of pages) have no text layer and come back listed in pages_without_text: OCR is not supported. Set include_lines to also get each line with its position in PDF points from the bottom-left of the page as the viewer sees it, the same frame pdf_edit uses, so you can stamp text next to something you found. Up to 200 pages per call; pass pages to read a large document in parts. pdf_find_text searches for specific text. With tables_format xlsx the tables come back as one Excel workbook instead (one sheet per table, all cells text). Read-only: the source is never modified.

include_lines.description: Also return every line of text with x, y, width and font size in points. Default false (smaller output).

pages.description: Pages to read, 1-based: "1-3,5,8-". Default: all pages.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

tables_format.description: csv adds a csv string (RFC 4180, CRLF line ends) to each table next to rows. xlsx instead returns one Excel workbook, one sheet per table ("Page 3 Table 1"), as an inline resource with a short summary (no text, lines or rows); every cell is a text string, never a formula, and numbers are not converted. xlsx fails with no_tables when the pages read have no table (if the read stopped early the error says so and names the pages value to continue with), and with an error when the workbook is over 4,000,000 bytes (read fewer pages). Default json. In csv cell values are returned verbatim: a cell starting with = + - or @ can run as a formula if the CSV is opened in a spreadsheet, so sanitise before opening.

name: pdf_extract_text

outputSchema.description: Without tables_format=xlsx: page_count, pages, pages_without_text and truncated. With xlsx: bytes, resource_uri, truncated, cells_truncated, and truncated_by when truncated.

bytes.description: Only with tables_format=xlsx: size of the workbook

cells_truncated.description: Only with tables_format=xlsx: a cell over 32,767 characters was cut

resource_uri.description: Only with tables_format=xlsx: where the workbook resource is attached

truncated_by.description: Only with tables_format=xlsx and truncated: which cap stopped the read or cut the workbook

title: Extract text and tables from a PDF
